description: Source code for ShareViewController, a UIKit-based iOS extension view controller handling content sharing, including extracting shared content, preparing UI, and communicating with the OpenClaw gateway.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: UIViewController subclass managing the share extension UI, content extraction, and message sending logic.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initializes the view, sets up UI layout and constraints.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Prepares the draft when the view appears for the first time.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures UI elements such as text views, buttons, and layout constraints.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared content and prepares the draft message.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Triggers sending the current draft message.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Cancels the share operation and dismisses the extension.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Handles the process of sending the message and updating UI based on success or failure.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Constructs and sends the message along with attachments to the OpenClaw gateway via a session.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Determines whether to retry connection with an alternative client ID based on error details.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays status messages to the user in a label overlay.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Creates a text draft from the shared content payload.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Cleans up a string fragment by removing certain phrases and lines.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Extracts shared title, URL, text, and attachments from input items.

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads image data from item provider, compresses, and encodes it for sharing.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Selects the most suitable image type identifier from registered types.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Produces JPEG data from UIImage, optimizing for file size.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads URL content from an item provider.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads text string content from an item provider.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads URL value from an item provider.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads text value from an item provider.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads raw data from an item provider.
